description: Add Maker-Checker (Writer → Reviewer → Published/Open) workflow for News, Bids, and Vacancies. Depends on FEAT-001 being done first (news route must use storage.ts before this can test correctly). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps: 1. In src/lib/storage.ts: extend NewsItem.status union from '"published" | "draft"' to '"published" | "draft" | "pending_review" | "rejected"'. Extend BidItem.status from '"Open" | "Closed" | "Awarded"' to '"Open" | "Closed" | "Awarded" | "pending_review" | "rejected"'. Extend VacancyItem.status the same way as BidItem. Also add optional fields to VacancyItem: salary?: string; location?: string; postedBy?: string; (these already exist in data/vacancies.json but were missing from the TypeScript type).
2. In src/app/admin/admin-content.tsx, update the NewsItem interface (around line 23): extend status to '"published" | "draft" | "pending_review" | "rejected"'.

3. In NewsForm component: change the status <select> in the Settings section to include all 4 options: draft ('📄 Draft'), pending_review ('⏳ Submit for Review'), published ('✅ Published'), rejected ('❌ Rejected'). Add a second action button 'Submit for Review' in the action bar that sets form.status = 'pending_review' then programmatically calls handleSubmit (or duplicates the fetch call with status overridden to pending_review). Keep the existing Save/Cancel buttons.

4. In NewsListPage component: add a Review Queue section rendered above the search bar and table. It shows only items where status === 'pending_review', in an amber-bordered panel. Each row shows: title, author, date, and two buttons: Approve (calls PUT /admin/api/news with { id, status: 'published' } then reloads) and Reject (shows an inline text input for a note; on confirm calls PUT /admin/api/news with { id, status: 'rejected' } then reloads). The panel is hidden if no pending_review items exist. In the status badge column, add cases: pending_review → amber badge '⏳ Pending Review', rejected → red badge '❌ Rejected'.
5. In src/app/admin/admin-content.tsx, update the BidItem interface: extend status to '"Open" | "Closed" | "Awarded" | "pending_review" | "rejected"'.
6. In BidForm component: extend the status <select> to include pending_review ('⏳ Submit for Review') and rejected ('❌ Rejected') options. Add 'Submit for Review' button in action bar.

7. In BidsListPage component: add Review Queue panel (same amber panel pattern) for bids with status === 'pending_review'. Approve → status 'Open'. Reject → status 'rejected' + note. Extend statusColor helper to cover pending_review (amber) and rejected (red).
8. In src/app/admin/admin-content.tsx, update the VacancyItem interface: extend status to include pending_review and rejected; add salary?: string; location?: string; postedBy?: string;

9. In VacancyForm component: add state fields salary: '', location: '', postedBy: '', status: 'Open' to the form state. Add inputs: Salary (text, placeholder '12,500 ETB / month'), Location (text, placeholder 'Sint Main Office'), Posted By (text, placeholder 'HR Department'), Status select (Open, Closed, pending_review as Submit for Review, rejected). In the useEffect load, populate these new fields. In handleSubmit, include them in the POST/PUT body. Add 'Submit for Review' button.

10. In VacancyListPage component: add Review Queue panel for pending_review vacancies. Approve → status 'Open'. Reject → rejected + note. Add a Status column to the vacancy list table with color-coded badge (green for Open, gray for Closed, amber for pending_review, red for rejected).

11. In src/components/vacancy-page.tsx: change the activeVacancies filter from 'vacancies.filter(v => !isExpired(v.deadline))' to 'vacancies.filter(v => v.status === "Open" && !isExpired(v.deadline))' so pending_review/draft/rejected vacancies never show publicly.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero TypeScript errors
storage.ts NewsItem, BidItem, VacancyItem status types include pending_review and rejected
VacancyItem in storage.ts has salary?, location?, postedBy? fields
Creating a news item and clicking Submit for Review saves it with status pending_review in data/news.json
Review Queue panel appears in News/Bids/Vacancies list pages showing pending items in amber
Approving a news item changes its status to published; it disappears from Review Queue
Rejecting an item changes status to rejected; it shows the red Rejected badge in the list
A vacancy with status pending_review does NOT appear on the public /vacancies page
Vacancy form now shows Salary, Location, and Posted By fields; they persist to data/vacancies.json
verification: npm run build — must exit with zero errors
In browser: open News admin, create article, click 'Submit for Review'. Confirm status badge shows amber 'Pending Review' and item appears in Review Queue.
Click Approve on the queued item. Confirm status changes to Published (green badge). Confirm data/news.json shows status: 'published'.
In browser: open Vacancies admin, create vacancy with Salary and Location filled. Confirm data/vacancies.json has salary and location fields.
On public site vacancy page: confirm only Open vacancies are listed after adding a pending_review one.
